title: Moraid language
extract: Moraid is a Papuan language spoken by the Moi Moraid people in the district of Moraid in the Bird's Head Peninsula of New Guinea. This language is mainly spoken in Moraid and several districts on the border of Sorong Regency and Tambrauw Regency, Southwest Papua.
